title: End or transfer a live call over REST
summary: Hang up a live call with a reason, send it to a new destination, or unbridge it from its peer, each with one REST command addressed to the call id.
scenario: Your agent desktop has a Hang up button and a Transfer box, and the call was not started by that page

folds: round 7 gap: live-call control over REST (5 of 31 commands covered)
